concerns.text: FR-001 mandates a fallback to 'generate simulated data or trigger a controlled data collection study' if no valid dataset is found. T012 (data_loader) is described as attempting a real fetch and then 'raising an explicit error to halt execution' if it fails, which contradicts the spec's requirement to proceed with the fallback. There is no task explicitly implementing the 'trigger controlled data collection' pathway as a fallback to the synthetic generation, only as a parallel prerequisite (T012b) that does not link to the failure of T012.

SC-005 requires the analysis to complete within 6 hours and <7GB RAM. T026c proposes a 'reactive' chunking strategy only if peak memory > 7GB is detected during execution. There is no task explicitly implementing a proactive optimization (e.g., batch processing, streaming, or memory-efficient data structures) to ensure the pipeline fits the constraints *before* execution, risking a failure to meet the success criterion.

FR-002 and FR-003 require computing time-series using OpenFace and librosa. T012_gen generates synthetic time-series using `synthpop`. The tasks do not clearly distinguish the execution path: T013/T014 (extraction) are not explicitly gated to run *only* when real data is present, and T012_gen is not clearly defined as the *replacement* for T013/T014 in the synthetic path. This creates ambiguity on whether the pipeline runs on fake data or real data, and whether the extraction logic is bypassed or duplicated.

SC-004 requires findings to be framed as 'associational (not causal)' in *all* outputs. T017 addresses this for 'console logs, CSV headers, report text' but does not explicitly cover the visualization (T023/T025) or the regression report (T020/T021). There is no task ensuring the plot title or regression table headers include the required disclaimer, risking a violation of the success criterion.

FR-001 specifies triggering the controlled data collection protocol *only if* no valid dataset is found in the registry. T012b and T012c implement the protocol, but there is no task explicitly verifying that the registry is truly empty before triggering T012b. This risks initiating an unnecessary human-subject data collection workflow.

SC-003 requires visualization quality to meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios *and* a minimum axis-label font size. T023 includes a `verify_wcag_contrast()` function but does not specify how the *font size* requirement is quantitatively measured or enforced, leaving the font size criterion unverified.
